title: Rare Earths: Strategic Minerals at the Heart of Energy Security 2026
gist: The text is a member-only video listing page, not a transcript: a 19-minute Giga Africa 2026 talk by Benchmark consulting head Shruti Kashyap titled 'Rare Earths: Strategic Minerals at the Heart of Energy Security'. Beyond the title-level framing no data is included.

insights.claim: Benchmark frames rare earths as strategic minerals central to energy security, not merely an industrial-metals market.
insights.speaker: Shruti Kashyap, Head of Consulting, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Treating rare earths as security assets supports price floors, stockpiling and state-backed non-China supply.
insights.quote: Rare Earths: Strategic Minerals at the Heart of Energy Security
insights.locator: Rare Earths: Strategic Minerals at the Heart

insights.claim: Benchmark placed a rare-earths session on an Africa-focused battery-supply-chain agenda, implying African rare-earth deposits are viewed as part of the diversification story.
insights.speaker: Shruti Kashyap, Head of Consulting, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: African rare-earth projects may gain from the same Western security financing directed at battery metals.
insights.locator: Rare Earths: Strategic Minerals at the Heart

insights.claim: The talk is delivered by Benchmark's consulting arm rather than price reporting, suggesting a focus on strategy and project advisory.
insights.speaker: Shruti Kashyap, Head of Consulting, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Benchmark is positioning consulting services for rare-earth supply-chain decisions.
insights.quote: Shruti Kashyap , Head of Consulting , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
